steps_0_7.detail: soft_start_bins ('1K','2K') / ('1K','2K','5K') does not include '10K'. WHERE bin_name IN (...) eliminates all noun/10K from SQL result.

steps_8_15.detail: 10K in WHERE clause (soft_start_bins includes '10K'), but target_bin='5K' puts 5K items first in ORDER BY. LIMIT 24 is filled entirely by noun/5K (153 available > 24 limit). noun/10K never enters the random selection pool.
steps_8_15.crowdout_threshold: 153 > 24 → all 24 pool slots taken by 5K items
steps_8_15.intended: EMERGENT — side effect of LIMIT 24, not an explicit design choice

steps_16_21.detail: target_bin='10K'. ORDER BY CASE WHEN bin_name='10K' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC puts all 13 noun/10K items first in the random pool. Random draw from LIMIT 24: 13/24 ≈ 54% probability per noun slot.

steps_22_23.detail: Same as steps_16_21 for normal path. Additionally, step >= question_limit - 4 triggers rescue with target_bin=None, soft_start_bins=None — full bank unrestricted.

observed_signal.context: Runs performed with 1 active noun/10K item (travesseiro only, pre-activation). 12/20 = 60% hit rate consistent with 1 item available in the primary window.
observed_signal.post_activation_expected_hits_per_run: 2–3 (13 items, ~54% per noun slot, ~4 noun slots at steps 16–21)

first_step_eligibility.note: Eligible from step 8 (in WHERE), but crowded out until step 16 where target_bin='10K'

six_choice_filter_risk.runtime_impact: NONE — modes/vocab/selector.py is not wired to runtime. services/vocab_runtime/selector.py has no choice count filter.
six_choice_filter_risk.future_risk: If async selector (modes/vocab/selector.py) is ever activated, 12 of 13 noun/10K items would be invisible. Flag for async migration.

verdict.explanation: Starvation in steps 0–15 is the correct behavior of the bin-ladder design. Steps 0–7 are intentionally restricted to 1K–2K for warm-up. Steps 8–15 target 5K. Steps 16–21 are the designated 10K window. The emergent crowding at steps 8–15 is not a design flaw.

rationale: 13 active noun/10K items is adequate for initial diagnostics
Late appearance is by design, not a bug
Activate next tranche only after observing real learner data on current 13 items
recommendation.watch_signal: If same noun/10K items repeat within 3 consecutive sessions, activate next tranche (~10 items from READY pool)
recommendation.deferred_action: Flag 6-choice incompatibility in modes/vocab/selector.py for async migration — no immediate action needed
